headline: Vet-formulated senior dog food with joint support
body: Optimize your older dog's daily vitality with exact nutrient ratios and transparent ingredients. Backed by clinical research for lasting mobility.
rationale: This copy targets the Wellness Optimizer by framing senior dog health as a system to optimize through precise science and transparent ingredients. It avoids discount messaging and novel gimmicks, appealing directly to her low price sensitivity and demand for evidence.
